name: Austin Proper Hotel
insider_take: This sophisticated downtown sanctuary perfectly captures Austin's "Keep It Weird" spirit while serving up serious luxury in the heart of Texas's creative capital.
whats_special: Austin Proper Hotel features original artwork from local artists throughout its interiors, a stunning rooftop pool with skyline views, and sits just blocks from the famous Sixth Street entertainment district. The hotel's design celebrates Austin's eclectic culture with custom furnishings and locally-sourced materials.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite facing west for unobstructed views of Lady Bird Lake and the best sunset photo ops from your private balcony.
dont_miss: The hotel's acclaimed restaurant Peacock Mediterranean Grill serves elevated Middle Eastern cuisine, while the rooftop bar offers craft cocktails with panoramic city views. Take advantage of the complimentary bikes to explore the nearby Austin City Limits Music Festival grounds and South by Southwest venues.
pros: Prime downtown Austin location near entertainment district
Stylish contemporary design with locally-inspired art
Rooftop pool and bar with city skyline views
High-end dining options and craft cocktail program
cons: Urban setting may involve city noise
